## Description

A wedge-shaped diatom (club-shaped in valve view, 13–75 × 7–17 µm) that lives attached, in colonies
on branched gelatinous stalks, on aquatic plants.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 4 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A [mucilage stalk](../../mechanics/stalks-and-colonies.md) secreted from the basal pole: hyaline, flexible, swaying
with the current. On dividing, each daughter secretes its branch: arborescent colonies (up to 16 cells
here). Width, bending and growth estimated.

## Literature

- Kreutz M., realmicrolife.com; Wang Y. et al. (1997) (mucilage stalk).
